subject: Mental Models
title: The 80/20 Rule in Action
description: A quick win: understand The 80/20 Rule in Action.

hook.text: Vilfredo Pareto noticed 80 percent of Italy's land was owned by 20 percent of the people. The ratio kept appearing.

buildup.text: Eighty percent of your results come from 20 percent of your efforts. Most of your work barely moves the needle.

discovery.text: Identify the vital few. A salesperson often earns most revenue from a handful of clients, not from cold calls.

twist.text: People resist cutting the 80 percent because it feels like slacking. It is actually ruthless prioritization.

climax.text: Apply 80/20 recursively. The top 20 percent of the top 20 percent yields a 64/4 rule. Focus sharpens power.

punchline.text: Find the 20 percent that matters. Ignore most of the rest.

quiz.question: What does the 80/20 rule reveal about effort and results?
options: A small fraction of efforts produce most of the results
You should only work 20 percent of the time
